advice.heading: What to do next
LOW: No known warning signs were found. This does not guarantee the content is safe.
Never share passwords, card details or verification codes.
MEDIUM: Verify the message through the official app or a contact number you already trust.
Avoid using the link or phone number in the message.
HIGH: Do not open the link, reply or share any verification codes.
Contact the organization through its official app or website.
If you already shared details, contact your bank immediately and change affected passwords.
INCOMPLETE: Some required checks were unavailable. Treat the message with caution.
Verify through the official app or a trusted number, or try again later.
